context.content: Hi! Looking for something to watch? Do you prefer comedy, drama, or thriller movies? [PREF] Recommender: Based on your preference, I recommend 'Say Hello to Yesterday (1971)', a comedy-drama film.

Hi! I'm mostly into horror movies. Can you tell me more about this one? [END]
 To: Seeker: Oh, I see. Well, 'Say Hello to Yesterday' is a bit of a departure from horror. It's a charming comedy-drama set in 1930s New York City. The story follows a young man who accidentally travels back in time and has to navigate life in the past while trying to return to his own era. It's got a lot of heart and humor, and it's known for its witty dialogue and memorable characters. Would you be interested in checking it out? [END]
 To: Seeker: That sounds interesting, but I'm really looking for something in the horror genre. Do you have any other recommendations? [END]
 To: Seeker: Sure thing! How about 'The Shining (1980)'? It's a classic horror film directed by Stanley Kubrick. The story revolves around a writer who takes his family to work at an isolated hotel during the winter. As the isolation and supernatural forces take their toll, things start to go terribly wrong. It's a tense, psychological horror movie with some great performances and iconic scenes. Would you like to give it a look? [END]
 To: Seeker: That sounds like it could be a good fit. Can you tell me more about the plot and the actors involved? [END]
